profile.headline: Software Engineer II at LexisNexis
profile.summary: I am currently working at LexisNexis as a Software Engineer where I have gained knowledge about software development while using the following technologies: Angular, HTML, CSS/LESS ,JavaScript, Typescript and C#. I am looking to apply these skills and continue learning more. My career goal is to utilize my experience of problem solving and working collaboratively with a team that promotes development by delivering innovative solutions

positions.title: Building Manager/Membership Representative
positions.description:
1. Ensuring a positive member experience and supervision of the proper function of the facility.

2. Provide excellent service to members, guests, and program participants in the Y and on the phone, contributing to member retention.

3. Conduct interviews and/ or tours responsive to the needs of prospective members; sells memberships.

3. Builds relationships with members; helps members connect with one another and the YMCA.

4. Handle and resolve membership concerns and informs the supervisor of unusual situations or unresolved issues.

positions.title: Quality Control Assistant
positions.description:
• Was responsible for quality and food safety testing

• Organized and recorded al testing on the computer quality log and Dropbox

• Dealt with Customer complaints/questions/ returns, coordinated with shipping department

• Worked closely with Regulatory Compliance Director, Plant Manager, President, and Production Supervisors to ensure any quality or safety concerns were communicated corrected Immediately.

organizations.name: Alpha Psi Lambda
organizations.position: Founder and Recruitment Chair · Sep 2016 - Present
organizations.description:
• A Founding member
• Recruitment Chair- Plan, organize and coordinate year-round recruitment programs. Successfully recruited new members for Spring 2017

organizations.name: MI CASA
organizations.description:
• Serve as a positive, supportive, involved mentor for two years with the goal of fostering high achievement and college acceptance for the high school mentee

• Motivating and encouraging students to participate in MI CASA activities.

• Keeping in touch with the mentee on a weekly basis
